subject: general
question: If x - (1)/(x) = 4, then the value of x³ - (1)/(x³) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If **x − 1/x = k**, then **x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k**.

Given **k = 4**.

∴ **x³ − 1/x³ = 4³ + 3 × 4 = 64 + 12 = 76**.

**∴ The correct answer is 76.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** x − 1/x = 4

**Formula Used:** (a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)

⇒ Cubing both sides of the equation: (x − 1/x)³ = 4³

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ − 3 × x × (1/x) × (x − 1/x) = 64

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ − 3 × (x − 1/x) = 64

⇒ Substitute the value **x − 1/x = 4** into the equation:

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ − 3 × 4 = 64

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ − 12 = 64

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 64 + 12

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 76

**∴ The correct answer is 76.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Identities for Reciprocals

If **x + 1/x = k**, then **x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k**.

Square Relations

If **x + 1/x = k**, then **x² + 1/x² = k² − 2** and if **x − 1/x = k**, then **x² + 1/x² = k² + 2**.

Power 4 Relation

If **x + 1/x = k**, then **x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (k² − 2)² − 2**.</p
